MY STORY

The Sunflower Narrative

From Ground Truth to Data Intelligence

🌱 The Root: Resilience & Ground Truth

My journey began with a move across the world, trading a career as a social science middle school teacher in China for a new life in Minnesota. Before I was a Data Scientist, I was a City Carrier for the USPS — learning every street, optimizing routes in dark Minnesota winters, maintaining a 99.9% accuracy rate.

🌻 The Stem: Growth & Adaptation

Like a sunflower that constantly turns to face the light, I have always moved toward growth. Being an immigrant means constantly translating — not just between Mandarin and English, but between cultural systems. I returned to school, maintaining a 3.9 GPA, to learn how to build bridges.

🌼 The Bloom: Impact & Innovation

Today, I am a two-time 1st Place Hackathon winner, but my real pride is in the impact. Whether building Team Doctor for nonprofits or creating a resource hub for newcomers, my goal is to be a “positive force” in the tech ecosystem.
